landing.heroSubtitle: Rinda ibyawe. Garura ibyabuze. Rejisitiri y'ikoranabuhanga y'u Rwanda.
landing.kizereProvides: Byose ukeneye kugira ngo ugumane ibyawe by'agaciro mu mutekano kandi umenye neza ko bibona inzira itaha mu rugo niba byabuze.
landing.feature1Desc: Fata ifoto y'ikiranga (barcode) cyangwa serial number, maze tubisome mu mwanya wawe.
landing.feature2Desc: Shyiraho inyandiko z'ubwishyu (receipts) kugira ngo ugaragaze ko ari icyawe.
landing.feature3Desc: Ibiranga byihariye ku bintu byawe bifasha uwabibonye kubisubiza bidatinze.
landing.feature4Desc: Bika amafoto asobanutse y'ibintu byawe kugira ngo bibashe kumenyekana vuba.
landing.feature5Desc: Reba ibintu byawe byose birinzwe kuri lisiti imwe yoroheje.
landing.feature6Desc: Umuyoboro w'abaturage biyemeje kugufasha kubona ibyabuze.
landing.joinThousands: Ifatanye n'ibihumbi by'abandi mu Rwanda bakoresha KIZERE mu kurinda ibintu byabo.

howItWorks.communityDesc: Ifatanye n'ibihumbi by'abantu barinda ibyo bakunda.

howItWorks.step2Desc: Turema inyandiko y'ikoranabuhanga yizewe y'uburenganzira bwawe.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Shyira akamenyetso ka QR kihariye ku kintu cyawe.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Niba cyabuze, uwakibonye asikana (scan) akamenyetso kugira ngo afashe kugisubiza.

testimonials.subtitle: Umva ubuhamya bw'abantu babashije kurinda no kugarura ibintu byabo by'agaciro.

testimonial1.name: James M.
testimonial1.quote: Nataye mudasobwa yanjye ku kibuga cy'indege, ariko kubera KIZERE, yansubijwe mu masaha 24. Sisitemu ya QR ikora neza cyane!

testimonial2.name: Francine N.
testimonial2.quote: Uburyo bwari bworoshye cyane, kandi nishimiye umutuzo mpawe no kumenya ko ibyawe by'agaciro birinzwe na gihamya y'ikoranabuhanga.

testimonial3.name: Robert K.
testimonial3.quote: Igihe telefone yanjye yaturutse, uwakibonye yasikanye kode QR, maze mmenyeshwa ako kanya. Iyi serivisi ni ingirakamaro cyane!

mobileApp.description: Gera ku bintu byawe, cungira icyemezo (certificates), kandi usubize imenyesha ry'ibyabuze n'ibyabonetse aho waba uri hose ukoresheje porogaramu yacu.

features.feature1: Imenyesha ry'ako kanya niba ikintu cyawe cyabuze cyabonetse
features.feature2: Sikana (scan) kode QR uhereye muri porogaramu
features.feature3: Uburyo bwo kureba ibyemezo byawe ndetse n'iyo udakoresha interineti
features.feature4: Kwinjira mu buryo bwizewe ukoresheje bimometrike (biometric authentication)

faq.description: Bona ibisubizo ku bibazo bikunze kubazwa ku bijyanye na serivisi yacu.

security.question: Amakuru yanjye arinzwe gute kuri KIZERE?
security.answer: Dukoresha buryo bwo kurinda amakuru bwo ku rwego rwo hejuru kugira ngo turinde amakuru yawe. Amakuru yose yawe bwite n'ay'ibintu byawe arinzwe haba igihe yoherezwa cyangwa abitse, kandi dukora igenzura rya hato na hato kugira ngo tumenye neza ko amakuru yawe arinzwe.

items.question: Ni ibihe bintu nshobora kwandikisha?
items.answer: Urashobora kwandikisha hafi ya buri kintu cyose cy'agaciro harimo ibikoresho by'ikoranabuhanga, imitako, inyandiko, ibikoresho by'ubwiza, n'ibindi. Sisitemu yacu ikora neza cyane ku bintu bifite ibiranya byihariye nka serial numbers, IMEI, cyangwa ibindi biranga bihari.

lostFound.question: Uburyo bwo kugarura ibyabuze bukora gute?
lostFound.answer: Iyo hari umuntu ubonye ikintu cyawe, asikana (scan) kode QR iri kumwe nacyo. Ibi bihita bikumenyesha kandi bigaha uwakibonye uburyo bwirinzwe bwo kugushakira bitagaragaje amakuru yawe bwite kugeza ubihisemo.

limits.question: Ese hari umubare ntarengwa w'ibintu nkwiriye kwandikisha?
limits.answer: Konti zisanzwe zishobora kwandikisha kugeza ku bintu 5. Abafatanyabikorwa ba Premium bishobora kwandikisha ibintu bitagira mbibi kandi bakabona izindi serivisi nko gufashwa vuba n'uburyo bwisumbuye bwo kugarura ibyabuze.

faqs_page.title: Ibibazo Bikunze Kubazwa
faqs_page.subtitle: Byose ukeneye kumenya kuri KIZERE

questions.what_is_kizere_ans: KIZERE ni urubuga rwa mbere rwuzuye mu Rwanda rwo kwandikisha ibintu, kumenyesha ibyabuze n'ibyabonetse, no gucunga uburenganzira bwo gutunga. Dufasha kubaka umuco w'ubwizerane n'umutekano.
questions.is_it_free_ans: Gufungura konti isanzwe ni ubuntu. Kurinda ikintu cyo mu giciro cy'ibanze bishingiye kuri 2,000 RWF gusa.
questions.how_to_register_ans: Injira muri konti, kanda 'Andika Ikintu', maze ukurikize intambwe: tanga amakuru, shyiraho amafoto, kandi wemeze inyandiko z'uburenganzira.
questions.what_is_digital_cert_ans: Ni inyandiko yirinzwe mu buryo bw'ikoranabuhanga yemeza ko uri nyir'ikintu. Ikubiyemo amakuru y'ikintu, amafoto, n'ikiranga cyihariye.
questions.what_if_i_lose_it: Nyakora iki niba nataye ikintu cyanjye?
questions.what_if_i_lose_it_ans: Jya kuri 'Byabuze & Byabonetse', tanga raporo y'ikintu cyabuze, maze ugaragaze aho giheruka kuboneka n'igihe. Ubwenge bukorano bwacu n'abaturage bizagufasha kugishakisha.
questions.is_my_data_safe_ans: Yego, dukoresha uburyo bwo kurinda amakuru bwo ku rwego rwa banki kandi twubahiriza amateka y'u Rwanda ajyanye no kurinda amakuru bwite.

faqs_page.contact_us_text: Uragifite ibindi bibazo? Turi hano kugira nâ€™ugufashe kurinda ibintu byawe by'agaciro.

about_page.title: Kuri KIZERE
about_page.mission_text: Kubaka umuryango ukoresha ukuri kandi wizewe mu gutunga no kugarura ibintu mu Rwanda binyuze mu mishinga y'ikoranabuhanga.
about_page.vision_text: Kuba icyitegererezo mu kwemeza uburenganzira bwo gutunga no kugarura ibyabuze muri Afurika y'Iburasirazuba.
about_page.story_text: Yatangiye i Kigali, KIZERE yavutse biturutse ku kenerwa rya sisitemu imwe yizewe yo gucunga ibikoresho no gufasha kugarura ibyabuze mu mujyi wacu ukura vuba.
